author: Ankit
problem: board is a list of (name, score) pairs sorted from highest to lowest score. Return a new board with the player added in score order, where players who reached a score earlier stay ahead of newcomers with the same score.
bug_description: The position search uses > instead of >=, so a newcomer is placed ahead of existing players with the same score.

comments.accurate: Adds the player in score order; players already on the board keep their place on ties
comments.wrong_behavior: Adds the player in score order, ahead of anyone with the same score
comments.wrong_location: Position search verified; make sure the original board list isn't modified
